stateSource: run status text (Simulation::getStatusText), independent of the cppprops path
note: state traces are the evaluator's INPUT; farm logs are the EXPECTED OUTPUT
foodPatchesKeyNote: steps[i]["foodPatches"]["<domain>.<patch>"]["agentInsideCount"] = FoodPatch::agentInsideCount as printed by Simulation::getStatusText for step i; agentNeighborhoodCount is the printed inside+neighborhood column minus inside
metabolismKeyNote: metabolism<j> = fNumberAliveWithMetabolism[ Metabolism::get( j )->index ]; the printed order IS the definition order, and the names above are what the run's status text printed for those indices
